statement: golden_fraction counts only nodes whose provenance is in {authored, captured, attested, reconstructed-then-ratified} toward the golden numerator; reconstructed (and absent-provenance) nodes never count, and an empty node list yields 0% rather than an error.
note: A ratified reconstruction counts as golden; an unratified one and an absent value do not. 4 of 6 = 66.7%, reported as the integer 67.
